NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Moki Rescue uses location when customers choose a pickup point. Dispatch uses shop coordinates; Google Maps uses your current location when you open navigation.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Moki Rescue does not use background location. Dispatch uses shop coordinates.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Moki Rescue does not use background location.
